# hetznerrobot_server (Resource)

An existing dedicated server, adopted by its number — the webservice cannot create one here (order it with `hetznerrobot_server_order` or `hetznerrobot_server_market_order`). Only the name is managed. Destroying the resource only forgets the server; it keeps running and stays billed. Cancel it with `hetznerrobot_server_cancellation`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Adopts an existing server; only the name is managed.
resource "hetznerrobot_server" "web" {
  server_number = 321
  server_name   = "web1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_number` (Number) Server number (the server's id in Robot).

### Optional

- `server_name` (String) Name of the server as shown in Robot.

### Read-Only

- `cancelled` (Boolean) Whether the server is cancelled.
- `cpanel` (Boolean) Whether the cPanel installation is available.
- `dc` (String) Data center, e.g. `FSN1-DC14`.
- `hot_swap` (Boolean) Whether hot swap is available.
- `ips` (List of String) Single IP addresses assigned to the server.
- `linked_storagebox` (Number) Id of the linked Storage Box, if any.
- `paid_until` (String) Paid-until date (`yyyy-MM-dd`).
- `plesk` (Boolean) Whether the Plesk installation is available.
- `product` (String) Product name, e.g. `EX44`.
- `rescue` (Boolean) Whether the Rescue System is available.
- `reset` (Boolean) Whether the reset system is available.
- `server_ip` (String) Main IPv4 address; null on an IPv6-only server.
- `server_ipv6_net` (String) Main IPv6 net address.
- `status` (String) `ready` or `in process`.
- `subnets` (Attributes List) Subnets assigned to the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))
- `traffic` (String) Free traffic quota; `unlimited` for unlimited traffic.
- `vnc` (Boolean) Whether the VNC installation is available.
- `windows` (Boolean) Whether the Windows installation is available.
- `wol` (Boolean) Whether Wake on LAN is available.

<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) Net address.
- `mask` (String) Prefix length, e.g. `64`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hetznerrobot_server.web 321
```
